name: WhatsApp
description: Link your WhatsApp account to search conversations, read history, send messages and attachments, and manage chats.

setup.title: Connect WhatsApp
setup.description: Link WhatsApp on your phone by scanning a QR code. OpenTeam handles setup automatically.
steps: Choose Connect to display a QR code.
On your phone, open WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan the code.
Keep WhatsApp open while linking and initial history sync finish. New codes appear automatically.

deviceLink.instructions: In WhatsApp on your phone, open Settings → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan this code. Keep WhatsApp open while linking finishes.

skills.name: whatsapp
skills.description: Search and read WhatsApp conversations, resolve contacts, send messages and attachments, reply, react, or change chat state through the connected account's tools.

skills.name: whatsapp-setup
skills.description: Check WhatsApp sync and history coverage, explain account-settings linking, recover a disconnected session, or remove the device.

installationSteps: Scan the QR code using WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device on your phone.
Keep WhatsApp open until the account says Connected.
